item.title: Maui Housing Policy Divides Top Candidates For Mayor This Election
item.description: Maui County Council member Yuki Lei Sugimura is trying to unseat Mayor Richard Bissen in a closely watched race this election.

item.title: E Holo Nā Papahana Hoʻolako Hale Pekelala A I Ka 2027 No Nā Kānaka O Maui I Pau Ahi Ka Hale
item.description: E holo ka papahana a i Pepeluali 10, 2027.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Needs Leadership To Make Energy Affordable, Not ‘Natural’ Gas
item.description: There will be no immediate relief by importing LNG, and maybe no relief at all.

item.title: Hawaiian Royalty Burial Grounds: Lawmakers Punt On Oversight Woes
item.description: Lawmakers are hesitant to move quickly on the sensitive issue and want a task force to come back in two years with a proposal for how to oversee Mauna ‘Ala.

item.title: The Friday Crossword: Golf Game
item.description: This one's better than the19th hole if you're looking for a break.

item.title: What Happens When The Governor Can’t Trust His Lieutenant Governor?
item.description: The two may seem like a team but the Legislature is the only authority that can remove an elected official from office in Hawaiʻi.

item.title: Kauaʻi Mayor Campaign Fundraising: Rapozo Outpacing Carvalho
item.description: County Council Chair Mel Rapozo is raising and spending more money than his council colleague Bernard Carvalho Jr. in their bid to be Kauaʻi's next mayor.

item.title: Lobbyist Under Fire Tied To Taxpayer-Funded Kidney Center That Was Never Built
item.description: Records show firms associated with politically connected contractor Dennis Mitsunaga collected nearly $1.8 million for a Kapolei building that has never materialized.

item.title: Kirstin Downey: Robocalls Drop Faster In Hawaiʻi Than U.S. — But Not Enough
item.description: The bipartisan fight against telephone scammers is gaining traction, but predatory calls are still far too common.

item.title: Hawaiʻi AG Not Giving Up $35K Paper Bag Case
item.description: The islands’ chief law enforcement officer asked for patience with her office's investigation into who received the money.
